indicators.name: 销售额
indicators.definition: 有效订单的不含税商品销售额,按下单日汇率折算为人民币。不含运费和税费。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS sales_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:不含税商品销售额(item_amount),不含运费、税费;排除 Canceled/Pending;按下单日汇率折算人民币。 item_amount 是不含税金额,tax_amount 不参与。

indicators.name: 订单量
indicators.definition: 有效订单的去重订单数。一个订单可含多个商品行,必须按 order_id 去重。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM amz_order_items o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')
indicators.notes: 不要用 COUNT(*),明细表是订单商品行粒度。

indicators.name: 销量
indicators.definition: 有效订单的商品件数合计。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(o.quantity) AS units FROM amz_order_items o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')

indicators.name: 客单价
indicators.definition: 每笔有效订单的平均销售额(人民币)。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS avg_order_value FROM amz_order_items o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')
indicators.notes: 分母用 NULLIF 防止除零。

indicators.name: 商品成本
indicators.definition: 已售商品的成本 = (采购成本 + 头程运费) × 销量,单位人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM((p.unit_cost + p.head_freight_cost) * o.quantity) AS cogs_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN dim_products p ON o.store_id = p.store_id AND o.msku = p.msku WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:(unit_cost + head_freight_cost) × 销量,即采购成本加头程运费,取 dim_products 当前成本。dim_products 在 (store_id, msku) 上唯一,JOIN 不会放大。 dim_products 须在 (store_id, msku) 上唯一,否则会重复计算。

indicators.name: 平台费用
indicators.definition: 结算数据中的销售佣金、FBA 配送费、仓储费合计(取正数表示成本),人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT -SUM(s.amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS fee_cny FROM amz_settlement s JOIN exchange_rates r ON s.posted_date = r.rate_date AND s.currency = r.currency WHERE s.fee_type IN ('commission', 'fba_fee', 'storage_fee')
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:结算表中 commission、fba_fee、storage_fee 三类的相反数(结算费用为负)。不含促销与退款。结算按入账日期,与下单日期不同期。 结算按入账日期,与订单日期不同期,按日期比较时会错位。

indicators.name: 广告花费
indicators.definition: 广告日报中的广告花费合计,人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.spend * r.rate_to_cny) AS ad_spend_cny FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:以广告日报 spend 为准,不再加结算表中的广告扣费,避免重复。

indicators.name: 广告销售额
indicators.definition: 广告归因窗口内由广告带来的销售额,人民币。默认 7 天归因。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.sales_7d * r.rate_to_cny) AS ad_sales_cny FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:7 天归因广告销售额(sales_7d)。

indicators.name: ACOS
aliases: 广告花费占广告销售额比
indicators.definition: 广告花费占广告销售额的百分比。越低越好。
indicators.formula: 广告花费 / 广告销售额 * 100
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.spend * r.rate_to_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(a.sales_7d * r.rate_to_cny), 0) * 100 AS acos_pct FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency
indicators.notes: 结果为百分比数值,如 25.3 表示 25.3%。聚合后再相除,不能对每行 ACOS 取平均。

indicators.name: ROAS
indicators.definition: 每 1 元广告花费带来的广告销售额,是 ACOS 的倒数。
indicators.formula: 广告销售额 / 广告花费
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.sales_7d * r.rate_to_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(a.spend * r.rate_to_cny), 0) AS roas FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency
indicators.notes: 结果为倍数,如 4.0 表示花 1 元带来 4 元广告销售额。

indicators.name: CPC
indicators.definition: 平均每次广告点击的花费,人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.spend * r.rate_to_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(a.clicks), 0) AS cpc_cny FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency
indicators.notes: 按人民币折算。若业务习惯看站点原币,需另指定。

indicators.name: 广告点击率
indicators.definition: 广告点击量占曝光量的百分比。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(a.impressions), 0) * 100 AS ctr_pct FROM amz_ads_daily a

indicators.name: 广告转化率
indicators.definition: 广告订单数占广告点击量的百分比。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(a.orders_7d) / NULLIF(SUM(a.clicks), 0) * 100 AS ad_cvr_pct FROM amz_ads_daily a
indicators.notes: 使用与广告销售额一致的归因窗口。

indicators.name: TACOS
aliases: 广告花费占总销售额比
indicators.definition: 广告花费占全店总销售额(含自然订单)的百分比,衡量广告对整体销售的依赖程度。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT ad.ad_spend_cny / NULLIF(s.sales_cny, 0) * 100 AS tacos_pct FROM (SELECT SUM(a.spend * r.rate_to_cny) AS ad_spend_cny FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency) ad CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS sales_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')) s
indicators.notes: 跨表指标:时间范围条件需同时加到每个子查询里。 分子分母必须分别聚合后再相除,不能直接 JOIN 两张明细表(会重复放大)。

indicators.name: 毛利
indicators.definition: 销售额减去商品成本,反映产品本身的盈利能力,不含平台费用和广告。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) - SUM((p.unit_cost + p.head_freight_cost) * o.quantity) AS gross_profit_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN dim_products p ON o.store_id = p.store_id AND o.msku = p.msku JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:毛利 = 销售额 − 商品成本,不扣平台费用和广告费(扣完后叫「利润」)。 各公司口径差异大,请在《口径确认》中明确。

indicators.name: 毛利率
indicators.definition: 毛利占销售额的百分比。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT (SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) - SUM((p.unit_cost + p.head_freight_cost) * o.quantity)) / NULLIF(SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny), 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct FROM amz_order_items o JOIN dim_products p ON o.store_id = p.store_id AND o.msku = p.msku JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')
indicators.notes: 结果为百分比数值。

indicators.name: 利润
indicators.definition: 毛利扣除平台费用和广告花费后的利润。是否再扣退款损失、固定费用见口径确认。
indicators.formula: 销售额 - 商品成本 - 平台费用 - 广告花费
indicators.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(s.sales_cny, 0) - COALESCE(c.cogs_cny, 0) - COALESCE(f.fee_cny, 0) - COALESCE(ad.ad_spend_cny, 0) AS profit_cny FROM (SELECT SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS sales_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM((p.unit_cost + p.head_freight_cost) * o.quantity) AS cogs_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN dim_products p ON o.store_id = p.store_id AND o.msku = p.msku WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')) c CROSS JOIN (SELECT -SUM(s.amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS fee_cny FROM amz_settlement s JOIN exchange_rates r ON s.posted_date = r.rate_date AND s.currency = r.currency WHERE s.fee_type IN ('commission', 'fba_fee', 'storage_fee')) f CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(a.spend * r.rate_to_cny) AS ad_spend_cny FROM amz_ads_daily a JOIN exchange_rates r ON a.report_date = r.rate_date AND a.currency = r.currency) ad
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:贡献利润 = 销售额 − 商品成本 − 平台费用 − 广告花费;不含退货损失和固定费用。跨表指标,订单、结算、广告日期口径不同,短周期会有错位。 跨表指标:时间范围条件需同时加到每个子查询里。 模板已用 COALESCE 处理某一部分无数据的情况。

indicators.name: 会话数
indicators.definition: Business Report 中的商品详情页会话数合计。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(t.sessions) AS sessions FROM amz_traffic_daily t
indicators.notes: 粒度为 ASIN×日期。父子 ASIN 汇总时注意是否重复。

indicators.name: 转化率
indicators.definition: 下单件数占会话数的百分比(亚马逊 Unit Session Percentage 口径)。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(t.units_ordered) / NULLIF(SUM(t.sessions), 0) * 100 AS session_cvr_pct FROM amz_traffic_daily t
indicators.notes: 与「广告转化率」不同,后者基于广告点击。不要用订单表的销量除以会话数,口径与亚马逊后台不一致。

indicators.name: Buy Box占比
indicators.definition: 按会话数加权的 Buy Box 获得比例。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(t.buy_box_pct * t.sessions) / NULLIF(SUM(t.sessions), 0) AS buy_box_pct FROM amz_traffic_daily t
indicators.notes: buy_box_pct 存 0-100 的百分数。必须加权,不能直接 AVG。

indicators.name: 退货率
indicators.definition: 同期退货件数占销量的百分比。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT rt.return_units / NULLIF(sl.units, 0) * 100 AS return_rate_pct FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS return_units FROM amz_returns) rt CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(o.quantity) AS units FROM amz_order_items o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending')) sl
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:同期退货件数 ÷ 同期销量(非 cohort 口径)。退货有滞后,近期数据偏低。 跨表指标:时间范围条件需同时加到每个子查询里。 退货有滞后,近期数据偏低。

indicators.name: FBA可售库存
indicators.definition: 最新库存快照日的 FBA 可售件数合计。
indicators.formula: SUM(available_qty) WHERE snapshot_date = 最新快照日
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(i.available_qty) AS available_units FROM amz_fba_inventory i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM amz_fba_inventory)
indicators.notes: 库存是快照数据,不能跨天相加。查询某一历史日期时,把条件改为 i.snapshot_date = 指定日期。

indicators.name: 可售天数
indicators.definition: 当前 FBA 可售库存按近 30 天日均销量可以卖多少天。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT inv.available_units / NULLIF(sl.units_30d / 30, 0) AS days_of_supply FROM (SELECT SUM(i.available_qty) AS available_units FROM amz_fba_inventory i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM amz_fba_inventory)) inv CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(o.quantity) AS units_30d FROM amz_order_items o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending') AND o.purchase_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) sl
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:最新快照可售库存 ÷ 近 30 天日均销量。按 SKU 维度计算时需在两个子查询里同时 GROUP BY msku。

indicators.name: 高库龄库存占比
indicators.definition: 库龄 181 天及以上的库存件数占总库存件数的百分比(最新快照)。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(i.age_181_270_qty + i.age_271_365_qty + i.age_365_plus_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(i.age_0_90_qty + i.age_91_180_qty + i.age_181_270_qty + i.age_271_365_qty + i.age_365_plus_qty), 0) * 100 AS aged_stock_pct FROM amz_fba_inventory i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM amz_fba_inventory)
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:库龄 181 天以上(181-270、271-365、365+ 三段)件数 ÷ 全部库龄件数,取最新快照。

indicators.name: 滞销库存金额
indicators.definition: 库龄 181 天及以上库存按单件成本(采购+头程)折算的金额,人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM((i.age_181_270_qty + i.age_271_365_qty + i.age_365_plus_qty) * (p.unit_cost + p.head_freight_cost)) AS aged_stock_value_cny FROM amz_fba_inventory i JOIN dim_products p ON i.store_id = p.store_id AND i.msku = p.msku WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM amz_fba_inventory)
indicators.notes: 用成本估值,不是售价。

indicators.name: 回款额
indicators.definition: 结算数据中所有收支项合计(销售收入减去各项扣费后的净额),人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT SUM(s.amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS settlement_cny FROM amz_settlement s JOIN exchange_rates r ON s.posted_date = r.rate_date AND s.currency = r.currency
indicators.notes: 口径已确定:按入账日期(posted_date)汇总结算表全部 amount(含收入与费用的净额),不区分预留金。

indicators.name: 站点销售额
indicators.definition: 按亚马逊站点(US/UK/DE 等)汇总的销售额,人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT st.marketplace, SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS sales_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN dim_stores st ON o.store_id = st.store_id JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending') GROUP BY st.marketplace
indicators.notes: marketplace 枚举值见 dim_stores 字段说明。

indicators.name: ASIN销售额
indicators.definition: 按 ASIN 汇总的销售额,人民币。
indicators.sql_template: SELECT o.asin, SUM(o.item_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS sales_cny FROM amz_order_items o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.purchase_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Pending') GROUP BY o.asin ORDER BY sales_cny DESC
indicators.notes: 需要 TopN 时由问题决定 LIMIT。ASIN 与 MSKU 是一对多,按 SKU 看请改 GROUP BY o.msku。
